answer: Each agent locks bonded stake and commits to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations bind its Semaphore/RLN membership to a nullifier and message. Valid proofs allow messaging within the rate limit; duplicate messages under the same nullifier expose distinct Shamir shares, enabling recovery of the private identity key and attribution. The contract then slashes collateral immediately. This velvet rule leaves no hollow identities: every quill-signed proof is accountable to a bonded secret.
